passages.text: In a storybook, a village holds the same three festivals every year. The events follow a clear pattern: people gather, share songs and end with a meal. A new family wants to learn about the village's culture. The neighbours invite them to help put tables in the square. While working together, they hear old stories and ask about the festival food. The children learn a song and join the other children at the meal. By taking part, the family learns more than it can learn from pictures alone.

parallelText.en: In a storybook, a village holds the same three festivals every year.
parallelText.zh: 一本故事书里，一个村庄每年举办相同的三个节庆。

parallelText.en: The events follow a clear pattern: people gather, share songs and end with a meal.
parallelText.zh: 这些活动按清晰的模式发展：人们聚集、分享歌曲，最后一起吃饭。

parallelText.en: A new family wants to learn about the village's culture.
parallelText.zh: 一个新家庭想了解这个村庄的文化。

parallelText.en: The neighbours invite them to help put tables in the square.
parallelText.zh: 邻居邀请他们帮忙在广场摆桌子。

parallelText.en: While working together, they hear old stories and ask about the festival food.
parallelText.zh: 一起做事时，他们听老故事，询问节庆食物。

parallelText.en: The children learn a song and join the other children at the meal.
parallelText.zh: 孩子们学了一首歌，用餐时加入其他孩子。

parallelText.en: By taking part, the family learns more than it can learn from pictures alone.
parallelText.zh: 通过参与，这家人学到的比只看图片更多。

wordHelp.meaning: a way that events happen in order
a special event with shared activities

passages.text: The science club has a garden beside the school kitchen. At the start of the term, the pupils divide it into two growing areas. They choose beans as one crop and plant rice in the other area. Each group makes a label so visitors know what grows there. Mia records the plant heights, and Ben checks the water each morning. They compare their notes to see how the two growing areas change. The club plans to show these notes beside the plants on the school open day.

parallelText.en: The science club has a garden beside the school kitchen.
parallelText.zh: 科学社团在学校厨房旁有一块园地。

parallelText.en: At the start of the term, the pupils divide it into two growing areas.
parallelText.zh: 学期开始时，学生把园地分成两个种植区。

parallelText.en: They choose beans as one crop and plant rice in the other area.
parallelText.zh: 他们选择豆类作为一种作物，在另一区种水稻。

parallelText.en: Each group makes a label so visitors know what grows there.
parallelText.zh: 每组制作标牌，让访客知道那里种着什么。

parallelText.en: Mia records the plant heights, and Ben checks the water each morning.
parallelText.zh: 米娅记录植株高度，本每天早晨检查水。

parallelText.en: They compare their notes to see how the two growing areas change.
parallelText.zh: 他们比较记录，看看两个种植区怎样变化。

parallelText.en: The club plans to show these notes beside the plants on the school open day.
parallelText.zh: 社团计划在学校开放日把记录展示在植物旁。

how tall a plant is
